humanEdits: Defined a fixed four-by-four semantic atlas containing four frames, four scalable panels, and eight HUD/page icons from repository UI requirements
Used distinct silhouette and grayscale motifs for standard, focused, disabled, danger, health, shield, experience, level, time, objective, map, and lock states
Reserved exact danger red only for frame.danger and retained color-independent triangular warning corners
Assigned 64-pixel final nine-slice borders to frame and panel sprites while icons retain zero border
Approved the first deterministic generation with source margins 57-264 pixels and final margins 28-132 pixels; all sixteen cells are unique in color and grayscale
No manual raster repaint, generative AI, external visual reference, third-party asset, text, font, logo, watermark, or trademark was used
steamDisclosureCategory: first-party deterministic procedural vector raster; no generative AI and no runtime generation
notes: The 4096x4096 RGBA source and 2048x2048 RGBA final contain no embedded text. Final cells are 512x512 with transparent corners. Frame coverage is 10.63%-26.06%, panel coverage 76.02%-76.43%, and icon coverage 8.94%-20.56%. Only frame.danger contains reserved exact danger red.
